name: Short Cut Lemon Pepper Tilapia with Garlic-Herb Potatoes, Snap Peas & Almonds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add snap peas and almonds; cook, stirring occasionally, until the peas are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
2 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
⅓ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, remove sleeve and spice packet from the potatoes; place package (do not remove or puncture film) in the microwave. Microwave on high for 5 ½ minutes, let stand for 1 minute, then remove from microwave. Carefully remove film, then add butter, season with spice packet (to taste), and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (454 g) pkg ready-to-use microwavable potatoes, garlic-herb flavor
1 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: While the potatoes are cooking, pat tilapia dry with paper towels and place on a plate.  Sprinkle with lemon pepper seasoning on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g tilapia fillet
1 tbsp lemon pepper seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tilapia and cook, flipping once, until fish is crispy and easily flakes with a fork, about 6 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide tilapia, potatoes, snap peas, and almonds between plates. Enjoy!
